summary: Tested ToolsPanel (premium glass 4x2 tools panel) + room background AI moderation (Gemini Vision). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (login, background safe-upload fail-open, filename-blocklist, non-owner 403, static-code-check that ai_moderate_image is invoked, dados/ruleta/mora/ghost-mode endpoints). Frontend: ToolsPanel opens correctly with dark translucent glass background, 8 circular gradient icons (Sorpresa/Número/Dado/Mora/Conmutación Id/Borrar todo/Música/Efecto) all with data-testid, correct labels in white text, SVGs use custom gradient fills (8 of 9 gradient IDs present — env1 is dead code), tool-effect shows 💥 emoji at 120px, tool-clear empties chat, tool-sorpresa opens Cofres panel, backdrop click closes panel.
action_items: (Very low priority) ToolsPanel.js defines EnvelopeIcon with gradient id 'env1' but it is never used — the 'numero' slot uses RouletteIcon (gradient 'r1'). Remove EnvelopeIcon + env1 <defs> to clean dead code.

(Info) GEMINI_API_KEY in backend/.env is the literal string 'placeholder_key'. ai_moderate_image fails open (returns SAFE on API error) as designed. Before shipping, set a real Gemini API key so vision moderation actually runs; otherwise nudity/weapons/violence are only caught via filename keywords.

(Low) Entry animation 'LA TORMENTA HA LLEGADO' overlay (~6-7s) blocks clicks on bottom-bar buttons. Not a bug (by design), but main agent may want a skip / lower z-index on interactive bars once animation is past half-way.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_moderate_image correctly fails open on missing/bad API key and on exception — good defensive pattern. However, GEMINI_API_KEY='placeholder_key' passes the `if not api_key` guard so it reaches google.genai.Client and only fails inside the try/except. Consider validating the key format (e.g., reject obvious placeholders) or logging a WARNING at startup when key looks invalid.
ToolsPanel.js EnvelopeIcon component and its <defs id='env1'> are declared but not referenced in the `tools` array (Número uses RouletteIcon with gradient r1). Dead code — ~15 lines to remove.

RoomView.js quickRuleta/quickDados/quickMora hard-code bet=1000 with no balance check in the UI — backend correctly returns 400 if insufficient, and the code surfaces e.response.data.detail, but a UX improvement would be to disable the button or show a tooltip if coins<1000.
ToolsPanel backdrop uses backdrop-filter blur(8px) — on Safari iOS this requires -webkit-backdrop-filter which is already set ✓.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ToolsPanel mounts with 8 data-testid tool-* buttons. To reach it: login Melvin_Live/test123 → click 'Mío' tab → click [data-testid='mio-btn-1'] → WAIT 7s for entry animation → click [data-testid='tools-panel-btn']. Gradient defs IDs in DOM: gb1, d1, r1, h1, s1, t1, m1, e1 (env1 is dead code). Backend GEMINI_API_KEY is placeholder → ai_moderate_image fails open which is the intended behavior.
rca of the issue: N/A — all reviewed features working as specified.
